newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to discuss cereals penalties again in April.
newsitem.headline: EU to discuss cereals penalties again in April.

text.p: European Union farm ministers will next month discuss again a proposal to make penalties for exceeding planting limits on cereals and oilseeds more flexible, an EU official said on Tuesday.

In the meantime the European Commission will hold bilateral discussions with Spain which is concerned that the lack of agreement means that provisions exempting its drought-hit farmers from penalties cannot enter into force.
Germany, France and Italy continue to demand a change allowing penalties to be targeted on those regions which exceed limits but this is not acceptable to the European Commission.
The Commission says that member states are demanding an increasing number of changes that will weaken 1992 farm reforms and make the penalty system too complex.
